sloka: देव देवी भृशं कृद्धा क्रोधागारमभिद्रुता ।प्रतीहार्या वचः श्रुत्वा राजा परमदुर्मनाः ॥२-१०-२१॥
transliteration: deva devī bhṛśaṁ kṛddhā krodhāgāramabhidrutā ।pratīhāryā vacaḥ śrutvā rājā paramadurmanāḥ ॥2-10-21॥

translations.english: Hearing the words of the doorkeeper, the melancholic king grieved all the more with his senses agitated and unstable.
